gloss: to make stand out, to highlight, to accentuate

definitions.gloss: to make stand out, to highlight, to accentuate
definitions.explanation: To cause something to become more prominent, noticeable, or distinctive. The causative form of {際立|きわだ}つ (to stand out).

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}いアクセサリーが{服|ふく}を{際立|きわだ}たせている。
examples.english: The red accessory makes the outfit stand out.

examples.japanese: {照明|しょうめい}が{作品|さくひん}の{美|うつく}しさを{際立|きわだ}たせていた。
examples.english: The lighting was accentuating the beauty of the artwork.

examples.japanese: {白|しろ}い{背景|はいけい}が{文字|もじ}の{色|いろ}を{際立|きわだ}たせる{効果|こうか}がある。
examples.english: A white background has the effect of making the text color stand out.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
Causative form of {際立|きわだ}つ (to stand out, to be conspicuous). {際立|きわだ}つ → {際立|きわだ}たせる.

USAGE:
Common in contexts related to design, fashion, art, and presentation. The subject is usually something that enhances or highlights another thing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {引|ひ}き{立|た}てる: to set off, to make look better
- {強調|きょうちょう}する: to emphasize (more direct)
- {目立|めだ}たせる: to make conspicuous

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個性|こせい}を{際立|きわだ}たせる: to make one's individuality stand out
- {魅力|みりょく}を{際立|きわだ}たせる: to highlight the charm
- {違|ちが}いを{際立|きわだ}たせる: to accentuate the difference
